Name: Document Records ID
Description: The surrogate ID for the record. Supply for existing records only. You cannot supply this ID for new records.

Name: Country Name
Description: The name of the country for the document type, such as Canada or United States. Only supply when the document type is country specific.

Name: Document Code
Description: If not specified a document code will be automatically generated to uniquely identify the document record for the person and document type. If defaulting you must supply a source key for new records.

Name: Document Type
Description: The type of document this document record is for.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person this document record is for.

Name: Assignment ID
Description: A unique reference to the assignment the document record is applicable to.

Name: Assignment Number
Description: The number assigned to the person assignment to identify the assignment uniquely in document records.

Name: Attachment Entity Name
Description: Decommissioned: Not in use.

Name: Classification
Description: List of tags to classify and group document records.

Name: Comments
Description: The comments pertaining to the document record.

Name: Date From
Description: The date from which the document is valid.

Name: Date To
Description: The last date the document is valid.

Name: Document Name
Description: A name for the document record. Used to differentiate records when multiple documents are added for the same document type.

Name: Document Number
Description: A number to identify the particular document.

Name: Document Type ID
Description: A value to identify the document type uniquely. Use the surrogate ID, source key, or globally unique ID, applying a key type hint to the attribute name as required.

Name: Issued Date
Description: The date on which the document was issued.

Name: Issuing Authority
Description: The authority that issued the document.

Name: Issuing Country Code
Description: The legislation code of the issuing country.

Name: Issuing Country Name
Description: The name of the country that issued the document.

Name: Issuing Location
Description: The location at which the document was issued.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference for the person to whom this document record belongs.

Name: Publish
Description: Specify whether the document record will be made available from a specific date and viewable on the UI.

Name: Publish Date
Description: The date from which the document record will be made available and viewable on the UI.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
